title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Prefilled Kit Bundle
description: The Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Bundle combines the innovative Pyne Pod Prefilled Pod Kit with two additional 2-pod packs—giving you four extra pods on top of the two already included with the kit. That’s up to 1500 puffs of dual-flavour vaping straight out of the box, plus another 3000 puffs’ worth of flavour to keep your sessions going even longer. This smart and compact device is an exciting collaboration with nic salt maestros Pod Salt, and features two pod slots for a unique flavour-switching experience. Simply rotate the mouthpiece to alternate between your chosen flavours at any time. With rapid USB-C charging, magnetic pod connections, and inhale activation, the Pyne Pod is easy to use and built for everyday convenience. Each Pyne Pod Edition comes with two 2ml prefilled pods in complementary Pod Salt flavours. Choose from a wide variety of fruity, menthol, or tropical-inspired pairings such as Mango Ice and Mango Peach, Blue Raspberry and Mr Blue, or Watermelon Ice and Strawberry Watermelon. If you’re looking to explore even more devices like this, check out our full range of Prefilled Pod Vapes for a wide selection of flavours and kits. With two additional pack of pods (four pods total) included in this bundle, you can explore even more of the full 20-flavour Pyne Pod collection—each prefilled with smooth 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape.
